concepts.summary: Red zone two by two concept where the F runs the Spray, a speed cut or stick with the option to widen, and the Z runs a Whirl behind it. The Y drive is a shallow cross with a check slow note, the X runs a stick or speed cut, and the back is the outlet. Spray Out turns the F route into an out. Can R/P means it can be checked to a run.
concepts.progression: 1+ the F Spray, 1 the Y drive, 2 the Whirl, 3 the X stick, 4 the outlet, as best read from the pictures.
concepts.qb: Check Burst is the alert. Several routes carry a Save 2 note and a depth of 5 yards, or 1 yard into the end zone on third and fourth down.

positions.F: Spray: speed cut or stick, widen option. Out on the Out version.
positions.Z: Whirl, 1 yard into the end zone, Save 2.

alerts: Depth rule: 5 yards, or 1 yard into the end zone on third and fourth down.

concepts.summary: Three by one concept from a bunch. The Point side runs a corner with an inside release, a widen pivot and a flat, with the corner capped at the 6 yard line. The single receiver runs a Fade as the alert. The back is the outlet and Check Burst is the alert tag.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 on the flat, the corner and the pivot. Order unclear in the text.
concepts.qb: Fade alert to the single receiver. Check Burst.

positions.Y: Corner with an inside release, capped at the 6 yard line.
positions.F: Flat, 1 yard into the end zone, or 5 yards and 1 yard in on third and fourth down.

alerts: Fade alert on the single receiver.
Cap the corner at the 6 yard line.

concepts.summary: Chin is a choice in at 5 yards by the named receiver with a stick nod next to it and a flat china at 3 to 5 yards under it. Omaha China is a four step version of the china. Dart sends the named man on the dart route; Dart Read lets him read it. Chops is the two by two version with a check wide outlet. The outside receiver has a corner alert at 12 yards or a fade.
concepts.progression: 1 choice in at 5 yards, 2 stick nod, 3 flat china, 4 the corner or fade alert, as best read.
concepts.qb: Four steps. Flat china landmark: outside edge of the numbers to the field, two yards outside the numbers to the boundary.
concepts.hb: Flat china or check wide outlet, by the picture.

positions.Y: Choice in at 5 yards (Chin), or Chops.
positions.H: Chin Dart Read from the Speed Pack, or flat.
positions.F: Chin Dart from North Rt Close, or corner alert at 12.
positions.X: Corner at 12 yards or fade alert.
positions.Z: Dart at 5 yards, or stick nod.

alerts: Omaha China: four step version of the china.

concepts.summary: The same family as Chin but the named receiver runs the Mooch, a money route at 5 yards, with a widen go outside him, a stick nod, and a flat china at 3 to 5 yards. Omaha China is the four step china. Dart and Dart Read work as on the Chin page. Chops is the two by two version.
concepts.progression: 1 money route at 5 yards, 2 widen go, 3 flat china and stick nod, 4 corner alert at 12, as best read.
concepts.qb: Four steps. Corner alert at 12 yards.

positions.F: Mooch from Snug, or corner alert at 12.
positions.Y: Mooch Chops or Mooch Dart Read from South Rt Clamp.
positions.H: Mooch Dart from the Speed Pack.
positions.Z: Widen go, or dart at 5 yards.

concepts.summary: Two race routes cross the field at different levels, one deep and one shallow, with a pivot underneath and a Whirl by the outside receiver. The back is the outlet, or runs a Wheel when Scat protection is called. The deep routes are run 1 yard into the end zone and the cap is the 8 yard line. P.O.R. is printed on the whirl receiver; its meaning is unclear.
concepts.progression: 1 and 2 the deep and shallow race routes, 3 pivot, 4 outlet or P.O.R., as best read.
concepts.qb: Check Burst. Routes end 1 yard into the end zone, or at 5 yards on third and fourth down goal.
concepts.hb: Outlet, or Wheel on 2 Scat Racer H Wheel.

concepts.summary: Three by one version of the race family. One receiver runs a race back, coming back against the grain, while the others run the deep and shallow race routes and a pivot. P.O.R. race is printed on one route. The deep routes are 1 yard into the end zone and the cap is the 8 yard line. Five reads are numbered.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 5 on the race back, the deep and shallow race, the pivot and the outlet. Order unclear in the text.

positions.Y: Race, shallow or on the move.

concepts.summary: Three by one concept. The Attack route works to the goal line, with a seam stop or race next to it and a go or fade on the outside whose job is to clear, not to get the ball: if it is not thrown he turns it into a whirl. The H runs a Coin, with Check Coin as the pre snap call. Dare and Race change the inside routes, and Swirl Wide sends the X on a swirl at 10 to 15 yards.
concepts.progression: 1 the Attack route, 2 the seam stop or race, 3 the go or fade, 4 the outlet, as best read.
concepts.qb: Check Coin pre snap. Attack to the goal line.

positions.Y: Attack to the goal line, or race.
positions.F: Race, 1 yard into the end zone, or outlet.
positions.X: Go or fade. Do not look for the ball; run the whirl if it does not come. Swirl Wide at 10 to 15 yards when tagged.

alerts: Check Wide on the Swirl Wide version.

concepts.summary: Fly motion by the F who then runs to the flat, with the X on crossers (a low shallow cross and a high shallow cross drawn on the picture) and a cut route as the first read. One receiver works the back end line as the alert.
concepts.progression: 1 the cut, 2 and 3 the crossers, as best read.

concepts.pageTitle: JOE RT-LT FLOW-BOLT OAKLEY-COCO (CAN) ZONE ANSWER (EMPTY)
concepts.summary: An empty formation zone answer. Joe Rt or Lt sets the direction, Flow and Bolt are the motion versions. Two shallow crosses come from opposite sides with a corner over the top. Oakley and Coco are tags that change a named receiver's route (Y Coco, F Coco, X Low). C.O. is printed on the corner; its meaning is unclear. Can means it can be checked.
concepts.progression: 1 the corner, 2 the shallow crosses, as best read.
concepts.qb: Zone answer. Four steps with the Omaha on the Scoot Pack version.

positions.X: Shallow cross, or low cross on X Low.

formations: [11] SCOOT PACK LT B Z BOLT

concepts.summary: The Roll protection with Fly motion as a zone answer in the red zone. The back gets to the flat right away at 1 yard, the Y runs the low cross, a receiver runs a late down flat, and the outside man runs a corner, or a Husker corner at 12 with a me/you call on the Husker version. The F flies across.
concepts.progression: 1 the flat at 1 yard, 2 the low cross, 3 the late down flat and corner, as best read.
concepts.qb: Fake the midzone and roll to the call side (see the Roll protection page).
concepts.hb: Flat to the roll side, quick, at 1 yard.

positions.Z: Corner, or Husker corner at 12 with the me/you call.
